title: Neonatal Thrombocytopenia Among Newborns Admitted to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit
brief_summary: Thrombocytopenia is diagnosed when platelet count is lower than 150,000 U/L, it is a common hemostatic problem in neonatal intensive care units According to platelets count, it is classified into mild thrombocytopenia with platelet count 100,000 to 150,000 U/L, moderate thrombocytopenia with platelet count 50,000 to 100,000 U/L and severe thrombocytopenia that have platelet count less than or equal to 50,000 U/L.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. newborn (term and preterm, inborn or out born) aged from 1-28 day
2. platelet count below one hundred and fifty thousands unit/liter

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Infant above 28 days old.
2. Newborns have platelet count one hundred and fifty thousands unit/liter

Exclusion Criteria:
study_population: The study will include all newborns with thrombocytopenia either preterm or full term, inborn or out born cases who admitted to neonatal intensive care unit of Assiut University Children Hospital through one year.
